lines.text: That noise drives me up the wall.

data.define: Used when something bothers you a lot.

example.text: That noise drives me up the wall.

misuse.text: Don't tell your teacher she 'drives you up the wall'.

publish.title: What does "drives me up the wall" mean?
publish.value: Drives me up the wall = It annoys me. Example: "That noise drives me up the wall." (casual English).
